title: A Space manager who can open a Space's Journey editor can now save in it: the page and every edit action ask the same canEditJourney gate

source.ref: Found by the LIVE-689 builder (#3099): the editor page admits through canEditJourney, the edit actions through their own authorPlan (author or admin.access only); re-tested on main at 451c500f0; ADR-1686

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1686). FINDING (the LIVE-689 builder, #3099): the Journey editor at app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit admits a caller through canEditJourney (lib/journeys/authoring.ts: the author, a platform operator with admin.access, or a manager of the owning Space, canEditProfile, for a Journey not in the root space), but the save actions in app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/actions.ts gated on their own authorPlan copy (author or admin.access only), and setLeafAnchorAction on a third inline copy of the same. RE-TESTED FIRST (ADR-1082) on main at 451c500f0: the premise held. A Space editor opened the editor and every add, update, move, remove, compose, Vera change, anchor, warm-up and export came back "Only the author can edit this journey." THE RULE: team authoring. lib/journeys/authoring.ts says in its header that it is the one gate shared by the editor route and every editor server action, and every other editor surface already asks it: the settings, visibility, delete, cover and meeting actions (app/(main)/journeys/actions.ts assertOwner), the Journey guide (guide/actions.ts), the launch context and the event-to-Journey link. The edit actions were the one surface left on the older author-or-operator rule, so the actions widen to the page's rule; nothing narrows. WHAT CHANGED: authorPlan now returns the plan only when canEditJourney admits the caller, setLeafAnchorAction asks canEditJourney too, and the file no longer reads admin.access or compares author_id. The page comment says the page and the actions share the gate. app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/gate.test.ts runs the REAL canEditJourney with only its readers stubbed and asks the page and the actions the same question: a Space manager opens and saves (update, anchor, export), the author and an operator still do, a Space member who does not manage it and a signed-out caller are refused by both with nothing written, and a personal (root space) Journey admits no Space managers. The manager case fails on main. No migration.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1686). The probe passes: the editor page and all 18 exported edit actions gate on canEditJourney, and canEditJourney still admits a manager of the owning Space.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error("LIVE-732: "+m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))fail(f+" is gone");return fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")};const strip=(s)=>s.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,"").replace(/(^|[^:])\/\/.*$/gm,"$1");const G="app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/";const A=strip(read(G+"actions.ts"));const P=strip(read(G+"page.tsx"));const L=strip(read("lib/journeys/authoring.ts"));if(!/export async function canEditJourney\b/.test(L)||!/canEditProfile/.test(L))fail("lib/journeys/authoring.ts no longer admits a manager of the owning Space (canEditProfile)");if(!/canEditJourney\(\s*loaded\.plan\.id/.test(P))fail("the editor page no longer gates on canEditJourney");if(!/import\s*\{[^}]*\bcanEditJourney\b[^}]*\}\s*from\s*\x27@\/lib\/journeys\/authoring\x27/.test(A))fail("the edit actions do not import canEditJourney, so they gate on a rule the editor page does not use");if(/admin\.access|author_id\s*[!=]==|[!=]==\s*\w+\.author_id/.test(A))fail("the edit actions re-derive the author or operator rule instead of asking canEditJourney");const g=A.match(/async function authorPlan\([\s\S]*?\n\}/);if(!g||!/canEditJourney\(/.test(g[0]))fail("authorPlan does not ask canEditJourney");const acts=A.split(/\nexport async function /).slice(1);if(acts.length<15)fail("only "+acts.length+" exported actions found in actions.ts, the split is broken");const bare=acts.filter((b)=>!/\b(authorPlan|canEditJourney)\(/.test(b)).map((b)=>b.match(/^\w+/)[0]);if(bare.length)fail("these edit actions skip the shared gate: "+bare.join(", "));console.log("ok: the editor page and all "+acts.length+" edit actions gate on canEditJourney, which admits a manager of the owning Space")'
verify.note: In-process, reads three files. The editor page must gate on canEditJourney(loaded.plan.id, ...); lib/journeys/authoring.ts must still admit a manager of the owning Space (canEditProfile); actions.ts (comments stripped) must import canEditJourney from @/lib/journeys/authoring, must not re-derive the rule (no admin.access, no author_id comparison), its authorPlan guard must call canEditJourney, and every exported action (floor of 15, so a broken split cannot pass) must call authorPlan or canEditJourney. Fails on main at 451c500f0 (the actions do not import canEditJourney). The behavior itself is locked by app/(main)/journeys/[slug]/edit/gate.test.ts.
